# SamToolbox - Comprehensive Technical Reference (llms-full.txt)
> Platform: SamToolbox (https://samtoolbox.vercel.app)
> Version: 2.0.0 (Enterprise Industrial Edition)
> Author: SamToolbox Team
> Updated: November 2026

## 1. System Overview & Architecture

SamToolbox is an all-in-one browser-native utility application engineered to deliver the capabilities of platforms like iLovePDF, Smallpdf, and regional financial portals without compromising user privacy.

### 1.1 Zero-Upload Architecture
- **Traditional Model:** Legacy PDF converters upload documents to remote cloud servers, process them via CLI tools (e.g., GhostScript, LibreOffice), and provide a temporary download link. This exposes sensitive personal, medical, legal, and financial records to third-party servers.
- **SamToolbox Model:** All file operations (parsing, rendering, re-encoding, encryption, merging, splitting, OCR extraction) occur strictly inside the user's web browser using client-side JavaScript, WebAssembly, and native Web APIs (Canvas API, FileReader, Blob, URL.createObjectURL).
- **Network Payload:** 0 bytes of document content are sent to any remote server.
- **Compliance:** Inherently compliant with GDPR (Article 25 - Data Protection by Design), HIPAA (Zero PHI transmission), and local state privacy regulations.

### 1.2 Technology Stack
- **Framework:** Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript
- **Styling & UI:** Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, pure vector SVG graphics
- **PDF Core Engines:**
  - `pdf-lib` (v1.17.1): Direct binary manipulation of PDF syntax, page trees, cross-reference tables, encryption dictionaries, and form fields.
  - `jspdf` (v4.x): Dynamic programmatic generation of vector documents, salary slips, invoices, and certificates.
  - `mammoth`: High-fidelity client-side DOCX parser for Word document extraction.
  - `xlsx` (SheetJS): In-browser parsing and serialization of spreadsheets (XLS, XLSX, CSV).
  - `jszip`: In-browser ZIP archive extraction and packing.

---

## 2. Exhaustive Tool Catalog & Technical Specifications

### 2.1 PDF Manipulation Suite

#### 2.1.1 Merge PDF (`/tools/merge-pdf`)
- **Function:** Concatenates multiple PDF documents into a single cohesive PDF.
- **Algorithm:** Uses `PDFDocument.load()` on each File ArrayBuffer, iteratively extracts page objects via `mergedPdf.copyPages(srcDoc, pageIndices)`, and adds them sequentially.
- **Input Formats:** `.pdf` (Multiple)
- **Output Format:** Consolidated `.pdf`

#### 2.1.2 Split PDF (`/tools/split-pdf`)
- **Function:** Deconstructs a multi-page PDF into discrete documents or extracts specific page ranges.
- **Algorithm:** Reads page indices from user input (e.g. `1, 3-5`), creates isolated `PDFDocument` instances, and saves them as individual files or bundled ZIP archives.

#### 2.1.3 Compress PDF (`/tools/compress-pdf`)
- **Function:** Optimizes PDF internal streams, strips unreferenced objects, and recompresses embedded raster assets.
- **Execution:** Pure client-side stream deduplication without compromising text clarity.

#### 2.1.4 PDF to Word (`/tools/pdf-to-word`) & Word to PDF (`/tools/word-to-pdf`)
- **Function:** Bi-directional conversion between editable Microsoft Word (`.docx`) and Adobe Portable Document Format (`.pdf`).
- **Engine:** Mammoth for client-side AST extraction and jsPDF/pdf-lib for vector page layout reconstruction.

#### 2.1.5 Excel to PDF (`/tools/excel-to-pdf`) & PDF to Excel (`/tools/pdf-to-excel`)
- **Function:** Parses workbook sheets, styles, and cell coordinates to produce printable tabular PDF pages or extracts tabular arrays from structured PDF streams.

#### 2.1.6 JPG to PDF (`/tools/jpg-to-pdf`) & PDF to JPG (`/tools/pdf-to-jpg`)
- **Function:** Embeds images (JPEG, PNG, WebP) into PDF pages matching exact image aspect ratios or extracts raster frames via Canvas rasterization.

#### 2.1.7 Protect PDF (`/tools/protect-pdf`) & Unlock PDF (`/tools/unlock-pdf`)
- **Function:** Implements standard 128-bit/256-bit AES PDF permissions and password removal for authorized files.

#### 2.1.8 Sign PDF (`/tools/sign-pdf`)
- **Function:** Interactive HTML5 Canvas signature pad allowing users to draw, type, or upload transparent PNG signatures and stamp them onto precise page coordinates.

#### 2.1.9 Watermark PDF (`/tools/watermark-pdf`)
- **Function:** Renders customized semi-transparent text or image overlays at specified angles (e.g. 45-degree diagonal) across all pages of a PDF document.

#### 2.1.10 Rotate PDF (`/tools/rotate-pdf`)
- **Function:** Modifies the `/Rotate` attribute in the PDF Page Dictionary (`0`, `90`, `180`, `270` degrees) without re-encoding media streams, ensuring instantaneous zero-loss processing.

---

### 2.2 Pakistani Regional & Enterprise Utilities

#### 2.2.1 FBR Salary Tax Calculator (`/tools/salary-tax-calculator`)
- **Applicable Law:** Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) Pakistan - Finance Act 2024–2026 for Salaried Individuals.
- **Tax Slabs (Annual Taxable Income in PKR):**
  1. `0 to 600,000`: 0%
  2. `600,001 to 1,200,000`: 5% of amount exceeding Rs. 600,000
  3. `1,200,001 to 2,200,000`: Rs. 30,000 + 15% of amount exceeding Rs. 1,200,000
  4. `2,200,001 to 3,200,000`: Rs. 180,000 + 25% of amount exceeding Rs. 2,200,000
  5. `3,200,001 to 4,100,000`: Rs. 430,000 + 30% of amount exceeding Rs. 3,200,000
  6. `Exceeding 4,100,000`: Rs. 700,000 + 35% of amount exceeding Rs. 4,100,000
- **Features:** Monthly net take-home calculation, tax breakdown, and instant downloadable PDF Salary Slip.

#### 2.2.2 Pakistani University Aggregate Merit Calculator (`/tools/merit-calculator`)
- **Institutions Supported:**
  - **NUST (National University of Sciences & Technology):** 75% NET Entry Test + 15% FSc/A-Levels + 10% Matric/O-Levels.
  - **FAST-NUCES:** 50% NU Test + 50% FSc (or 50% Matric / 50% FSc Part 1).
  - **MDCAT (Medical & Dental Colleges):** 50% MDCAT + 40% FSc Pre-Medical + 10% Matric.
  - **UET Lahore (ECAT):** 33% ECAT + 50% FSc + 17% Matric.
  - **COMSATS:** 50% NTS-NAT + 40% FSc + 10% Matric.
- **Output:** Exact aggregate score rounded to 4 decimal places with instant PDF merit certificate generation.

#### 2.2.3 Marla & Land Area Converter (`/tools/marla-converter`)
- **Regional Standards Handled:**
  - **Lahore & Urban Punjab (Zameen.com standard):** 1 Marla = 225.00 Sq. Ft.
  - **Rawalpindi / Islamabad / CDA standard:** 1 Marla = 250.00 Sq. Ft.
  - **Traditional Revenue (Patwari / Govt Settlement):** 1 Marla = 272.25 Sq. Ft.
- **Conversions Supported:** Marla <-> Kanal (20 Marlas), Acre (8 Kanals / 160 Marlas), Murabba (25 Acres), Square Feet, Square Yards (Guz), Square Meters.
- **Output:** Real-time multi-standard comparison table and formal property area report PDF.

#### 2.2.4 Zakat Calculator (`/tools/zakat-calculator`)
- **Jurisprudence:** Shariah standards based on Nisab threshold.
- **Nisab Standard:** Equivalent to 52.5 Tola (approx 612.36 grams) of pure Silver or 7.5 Tola of Gold.
- **Rate:** 2.5% (1/40th) of net eligible wealth held for one lunar year (Hawl).
- **Deductions:** Immediate liabilities, debts payable, and business operational expenses.
- **Output:** Asset-by-asset itemization with printable PDF Zakat Assessment.

#### 2.2.5 e-Stamp Paper Formatter (`/tools/stamp-paper-formatter`)
- **Context:** Punjab and Sindh online e-Stamp papers require a strict 110mm to 125mm top blank margin to accommodate the barcoded government header.
- **Solution:** Formats legal affidavits, rent agreements, and undertakings with exact 120mm top header margin, standard legal font sizing, line spacing, and margin guides ready for legal paper print.

#### 2.2.6 Passport & Govt Job Photo Resizer (`/tools/passport-photo-resizer`)
- **Compliance Presets:**
  - **NADRA CNIC / Smart Card:** 350x467 px, pure white background, under 50KB.
  - **FPSC / PPSC / KPPSC / BPSC Job Portals:** Under 25KB, 140x190 px, blue or white background.
  - **US Visa / DV Lottery:** 2x2 inches (600x600 px at 300 DPI), pure white background.
  - **Schengen Visa:** 35x45 mm, light gray/white background.
- **Processing:** Client-side HTML5 Canvas bicubic interpolation and JPEG quality optimization.

---

### 2.3 Financial & Academic Utilities

#### 2.3.1 GPA / CGPA Calculator (`/tools/gpa-calculator`)
- **Methodology:** Weighted Grade Point Average: `GPA = Sum(GradePoints * CreditHours) / Sum(CreditHours)`.
- **Grading Scales:** Standard HEC 4.0 Scale (A=4.0, B=3.0, C=2.0, D=1.0, F=0.0) and 5.0 scale.
- **Features:** Dynamic course addition, semester GPA calculation, cumulative CGPA tracking, and downloadable PDF transcript.

#### 2.3.2 Loan EMI & Banking Calculator (`/tools/loan-calculator`)
- **Formula:** `E = P * r * (1 + r)^n / ((1 + r)^n - 1)`
  - Where `P` = Principal loan amount, `r` = Monthly interest rate, `n` = Total months.
- **Output:** Monthly payment, total interest payable, total payment, and 12-month amortization schedule exportable to PDF.

#### 2.3.3 Compound Interest & SIP Calculator (`/tools/compound-interest`)
- **Formula:** `A = P * (1 + r/n)^(n*t) + PMT * [((1 + r/n)^(n*t) - 1) / (r/n)]`
- **Output:** Wealth accumulation projections with visual milestones and downloadable projection sheet.

#### 2.3.4 Invoice Generator (`/tools/invoice-generator`)
- **Features:** Itemized line items, quantity, unit price, multi-currency (PKR, USD, EUR, GBP, AED, SAR), configurable GST/VAT rates, and instant vector PDF invoice generation.
